subject: cult-info-dy
title: CULT.INFO.DY.------MT.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 79 (WAM-21). CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; MT-INFO (multi-information) is the partner. From the subject: POST (postulation), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of", and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From POST: CN-INFO (controlled information) and AFI (affinity insight). From T-C-IMP: TM (terminology—or terms of a definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From AFI: PR-TRS.
